items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 侦察骑士安柏，前来报到！今后有什么需要帮忙的，尽管说好啦！
items.text_en: Outrider Amber reporting for duty! Just say the word if you ever need my help!

items.title: 闲聊·兴趣
items.text: 好想跑一会儿步呀。
items.text_en: I feel like running.

items.title: 闲聊·挂念
items.text: 要是被琴发现我们在偷懒，她会不高兴的。
items.text_en: Jean will be upset if she catches us lazing around like this.

items.title: 闲聊·新发现
items.text: 那边好像有什么奇怪的东西耶…不去看吗、不去看看吗？
items.text_en: Hey, there's something strange over there... C'mon, let's take a look!

items.title: 下雨的时候·担忧
items.text: 下雨了…蝴蝶结会淋湿的…
items.text_en: Oh no, it's raining... now my uniform will get all wet...

items.title: 下雨的时候·提醒
items.text: 下雨了啊…视野会有影响，要小心哦。
items.text_en: It's raining again... This will hinder our vision, we must remain vigilant!

items.title: 雨过天晴
items.text: 唔哇~天气真好。
items.text_en: Wow~ This weather is awesome!

items.title: 阳光很好
items.text: 嗯…要是风大点就好了。
items.text_en: If only the wind was a little stronger...

items.title: 起风的时候·惬意
items.text: 真舒服呀…
items.text_en: This breeze... so refreshing!

items.title: 起风的时候·放松
items.text: 我喜欢这种天气，嗯…真轻松！
items.text_en: I love this kind of weather, ahh... so relaxing~

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 早上好哟！要不要一起晨跑？
items.text_en: Morning! Want to go on a jog?

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 可以跟你一起吃午饭吗？
items.text_en: Can I get lunch with you?

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 天黑了，要我点个火把吗？
items.text_en: It's getting late, should I light a torch?

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 没错，休息也很重要！那就说好了哦，明天见！
items.text_en: Agreed, getting rest is essential! Let's meet here tomorrow then. See ya!

items.title: 关于安柏自己
items.text: 蒙德城的飞行冠军，就是我啦！
items.text_en: Mondstadt Gliding Champion, yep, that's me! Gliding Champion!

items.title: 关于我们·比赛
items.text: 就算是你，比赛我也不会放水！
items.text_en: Remember that I don't go easy on anyone, even you!

items.title: 关于我们·飞行
items.text: 教你飞…与你一起飞行的时候，我自己好像也能飞得更快…欸，你在笑什么啊？来比赛吧！现在就比！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6When I'm teaching you to glide, I feel like I can go even faster than usual... Huh? What are you laughing at? I'll prove it! We can race — right now!

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 「神之眼」，是神对我的认可吧。嗯，我要成为最优秀的侦察骑士才行！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4My Vision... Is a sign that the Archons believe in me. Yes, I must become the best Outrider I can possibly be!

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 走嘛~去大教堂的钟楼上看看，风景超棒的！
items.text_en: The view from the Cathedral's clock tower is amazing! You should check it out.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 看，那里有鸽子！嗯…想跟它们一起飞呢。
items.text_en: Look, there's a pigeon over there! *giggle* I wish I could fly alongside them.

items.title: 关于琴·帮忙
items.text: 大团长出征之后，大大小小的事务都压在了琴的身上。如果我也能多帮到她一点就好了…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4After the Grand Master left on his expedition, all the affairs of the Knights of Favonius, both big and small, have been left up to Jean. If only there was more I could do to help her...

items.title: 关于琴·关怀
items.text: 琴可能还在工作？…走，一起请她喝杯咖啡吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Jean might still be working? We should invite her for coffee... Let's go.

items.title: 关于丽莎·听故事
items.text: 等你有空，我们一起去找丽莎吧！她上次和我讲了一个龙脊雪山宝藏的故事，只讲到一半。唔，我还想知道后续！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4When you have time, we should go see Lisa! Last time I saw her, she was telling me about a story involving a treasure in the Dragonspine area. But, we got cut off before she could finish. I can't wait to hear the rest of her story!

items.title: 关于丽莎·钦佩
items.text: 丽莎好像除了睡觉的时间都在看书！真厉害啊，我就坐不住那么长时间。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4If Lisa's not sleeping, she'll be reading! I don't know how she does it, I wouldn't be able to sit still for that long.

items.title: 关于凯亚·忧虑
items.text: …有种不安的感觉！刚才是凯亚陪着你吧？他没给你添麻烦吧？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4...I'm feeling uneasy all of a sudden! Was that Kaeya with you earlier? Did he give you any trouble?

items.title: 关于凯亚·祸首
items.text: 花圃里的蒲公英看上去蔫蔫的，哼…一定又是凯亚捣的鬼！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4There's something weird-looking about the dandelions in the garden... Hmm, I bet Kaeya had something to do with this!

items.title: 关于班尼特
items.text: 嗯？班尼特…好像在哪里听过…哦！你说的是冒险家协会那个热血的男孩子啊！嗯，我有时会在秘境附近见到他，好像对寻宝很有热情呢。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Hmm? Bennett... I feel like I've heard that name before... Oh! Yes, he's that hot-blooded guy from the Adventurers' Guild, right! I tend to come across him way out in the wild from time to time, he seems to really love treasure hunting.

items.title: 关于可莉
items.text: 可莉呀，偶尔会有点调皮，但骑士团的大家都很喜欢她！唔…为了不让她又被琴抓去关禁闭，还是看紧她一点吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Klee? She can be a bit cheeky sometimes, but everyone in the Knights of Favonius likes her. Although... I really ought to keep a closer eye on her if I wanna keep her from getting put in confinement by Jean again.

items.title: 关于阿贝多
items.text: 阿贝多，大多数时候都呆在自己的工坊里，捣鼓一些很厉害的东西。但是，见到他的时候，会有种猜不透他在想些什么的感觉。嗯，猜不透呢…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Albedo spends most of his time in his workshop, tinkering away with all of his awesome stuff. But, when you see him in person, you never can quite tell what he's thinking... Who knows what goes on in that mind of his...

items.title: 关于诺艾尔
items.text: 你问诺艾尔吗？她的韧性可是很强的。作为前辈，你也要多照顾她一点哦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4You wanna know about Noelle? She's super resilient. Still, since she's younger than us we should still look out for her.

items.title: 关于优菈
items.text: 优菈是我的好伙伴！只要习惯了优菈开的玩笑，你就会发现，其实她是很好相处的。只不过，优菈因为自己的姓氏，经常被很多人误解，怎么样才能让大家理解她呢…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Eula is a great friend of mine! You just need to get used to her sense of humor and you'll get along fine! The only reason she's misunderstood by so many people is her family name. How can I get them to see her for who she really is?

items.title: 关于柯莱
items.text: 柯莱和我写信说，她的「魔鳞病」已经彻底康复…我太为她高兴了！真想下一秒就飞到她身边，紧紧地抱住她。她还说很想念蒙德的大家，想等哪一天独当一面之后，亲口来汇报自己的成长…啊，要是能赶上下一次羽球节就好了，我都快等不及了！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises"Collei wrote to me saying that her Eleazar has been completely cured... I'm so happy for her! I wish I could fly to her side right now and give her the biggest hug! She also said she misses everyone in Mondstadt, and that once she's ready, she'll come visit us in person and tell us all about her progress... Oh, it would be great if she could make it in time for the next Ludi Harpastum. Aaah I can't wait to see her again!

items.title: 关于米卡
items.text: 哦，米卡是优菈那儿的老队员了，最初可能是看我和优菈关系比较好吧，总是长官长官地叫我。在我跟他分享自己的侦察心得之后，他又改叫我前辈了…弄得我挺不好意思的。明明我们的职责不一样，他在绘制地图上的专业性，是我怎么都比不上的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Oh! Mika's a veteran of Eula's team. When he first arrived, it was always "Yes, Commander!" every time he spoke to me — I guess it must have been because he saw how close I was with Eula. But then, even after I told him I was actually an Outrider, he still called me "Ma'am"... It was so embarrassing. We have completely different responsibilities, after all. I definitely could never match his expertise in cartography.

items.title: 想要了解安柏·其一
items.text: 狩猎我也很擅长哦！怎么样，想不想看看我的身手？还是…要来个狩猎比赛？
items.text_en: I'm a pro at hunting, you know! How about I show you some of my skills? Or even better... how about a little competition?

items.title: 想要了解安柏·其二
items.text: 和你分享我的飞行冠军经验吧！最重要的，就是要有勇气！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3I'll share my ultimate Gliding Champion secret with you! The most important thing to remember, is to have courage!

items.title: 想要了解安柏·其三
items.text: 其实我不擅长解谜，羽球节里看到猜谜的摊位都要绕着走…你呢？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I'm really not that good with riddles. I always try to avoid the riddles stand during Ludi Harpastum... What about you?

items.title: 想要了解安柏·其四
items.text: 我因为爷爷才加入骑士团，因为琴留在了团里。现在，是你陪我见到了蒙德以外的天空。我真的很开心。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5I joined the Knights because of my grandpa, I stayed because of Jean. And now, you're the one that showed me the world beyond Mondstadt. I couldn't be happier.

items.title: 想要了解安柏·其五
items.text: 我还想去更远的世界。我想去看天空的尽头！你也会继续陪着我的，对吧、对吧？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6I would like to explore the other worlds beyond. I wanna see how deep the rabbit hole goes! You'll keep me company, right?

items.title: 安柏的爱好
items.text: 兔兔伯爵，今天也是干干净净的一天！
items.text_en: Baron Bunny, today is another squeaky clean day!

items.title: 安柏的烦恼
items.text: 唔…你知道，怎样才能做出好吃的月亮派吗？
items.text_en: Oh... Do you have any idea how to make a decent Moon Pie?

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 琴泡的咖啡真的好香！有机会你要尝尝哦。
items.text_en: Jean makes the most amazing cup of coffee! You'll have to try it sometime.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 只要不是冰钩钩果汁…唔…我都应付得来！
items.text_en: I can handle anything and everything! As long as it isn't cold Wolfhook juice... Ugh, yuck...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 哇，这个太好吃了。你真厉害！
items.text_en: Wow! This is delicious, you're an amazing cook!

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 要是我也有这样的手艺就好了…
items.text_en: I wish I was as good at cooking as you...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 我不太习惯这种味道，抱歉啦！不是你的问题！
items.text_en: Uh, I'm just not used to this taste, sorry! Nothing to do with you of course!

items.title: 生日
items.text: 嘿嘿嘿，生日快乐！来，这个给你，是我亲手缝的「兔兔伯爵·特别定制版」…放心放心，是特别定制版哦，不会爆炸的！
items.text_en: Hey, happy birthday! Here, I have a gift for you: an exclusive, custom-made version of Baron Bunny that I sewed for you myself. ...Don't worry, "custom-made" means that it won't explode!

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 哇！像乘着风一样轻快~
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 1Yeah! As fast as riding the wind!

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 现在的速度，没有人能追得上了吧！
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 2At this speed, no one can keep up with me!

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 蒙德的天空好像变小了…还是因为我的视野变大了？
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 4The skies over Mondstadt seem to have gotten smaller... or is it that my sight reaches further than ever before?

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 我现在…比起最初跟你认识的时候，又进步了不少吧。嘿嘿，非常感谢！让我请你吃蜜酱胡萝卜煎肉吧，跟我来跟我来！
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 6It seems that now... I've improved so much compared to when we first met! Hehe, thank you so much! Let me treat you to a Sticky Honey Roast! Let's go, let's go!

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 靠你咯。
items.text_en: Get them!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 兔兔伯爵，出击！
items.text_en: Go go Baron Bunny!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: ♪哼哼~哼哼哼~
items.text_en: ♪Hmm~ hmm~ hmm~ hmm~ hmm~

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 百发百中！
items.text_en: No one escapes my sights!

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 箭如…雨下！
items.text_en: Let it rain!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 你没有退路了！
items.text_en: No escape!

items.title: 冲刺开始·其一
items.text: 来比赛吧！
items.text_en: I'll race you there!

items.title: 冲刺开始·其二
items.text: 跟得上我吗？
items.text_en: Betcha can't keep up with me!

items.title: 冲刺结束·其一
items.text: 说了你们跑不过我。
items.text_en: Told you I'd win.

items.title: 冲刺结束·其二
items.text: 就是这种感觉！
items.text_en: That's more like it!

items.title: 打开风之翼·其一
items.text: 我可是蒙德城的飞行冠军！
items.text_en: Get ready for the Gliding Champion of Mondstadt!

items.title: 打开风之翼·其二
items.text: 尽管交给我吧！
items.text_en: I won't let you down!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 打开宝箱的一瞬间，最兴奋了！
items.text_en: Opening a chest is like unwrapping a gift!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 侦察骑士，发现目标！
items.text_en: Another target tracked down by Outrider Amber!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 哇，都是好东西！
items.text_en: Wow, these will come in handy!

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: …我可不会认输！
items.text_en: I'll never surrender!

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 好痛…这家伙…
items.text_en: Ouch! Meanie...

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 别小瞧我！
items.text_en: *panting* Ugh... You'll... pay for that!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 小心啊！
items.text_en: Take cover!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 你…要不要紧？我来帮帮你吧？
items.text_en: Hey... Need some help?

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 跑累了…
items.text_en: Tired...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 训练…还不够…
items.text_en: Must keep... training...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 这次我…输了啊…
items.text_en: You got me...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 真难缠！
items.text_en: Hey!

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 好痛！
items.text_en: Ugh, not so hard!

items.title: 重受击·其二
items.text: 犯规啦！
items.text_en: That's cheating!

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 交给我吧！
items.text_en: Leave it to me!

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 准备就绪！
items.text_en: At the ready!

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 侦察骑士登场！
items.text_en: Outrider Amber, reporting!
